paper_title: Excess Electronic Recoil Events in XENON1T
notes: The paper reports a 3.4-sigma excess interpreted as solar axions, with a 3D 90% confidence surface for axion couplings to electrons, photons, and nucleons. The cuboid bounds quoted are: gae < 3.8e-12, gae*gan_eff < 4.8e-18, gae*gagamma < 7.7e-22 GeV^-1. These are limits on products rather than a single coupling vs. mass curve. The primary axion-electron limit is gae < 3.8e-12 (DFSZ/solar axion, not mass-dependent since solar axions are massless on these scales). For bosonic dark matter (ALP/dark photon), the paper sets limits on g_ae and kappa as a function of particle mass (1-210 keV), but the actual (mass, coupling) tabulated curve data are not present in the provided text. No extractable (mass_eV, coupling) pairs are available in the given content, hence data_points is empty. Confidence reduced because the paper involves multiple coupling types (AxionElectron, AxionPhoton, AxionNeutron, DarkPhoton) and no numerical curve data could be extracted.
